requirements.text: Communicates over the phone, listens well, and stays empathetic even when the caller is not calm
Remote customer service or contact center experience
Verifies customer identity and follows security and compliance protocols on every call
Moves between multiple systems and databases at once
Documents every interaction accurately in account systems and CRM tickets
Stays composed and solves problems in a fast-paced environment
Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet of 25 Mbps minimum, with a quiet home workspace
Completes program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding
Spots and helps resolve potential fraud

resumes.text:
Name: Marcus Oyelaran
Summary: Customer service professional with five years of experience in phone-based support, including three years on a remote contact center team handling banking and insurance accounts. Calm under pressure, detail-driven, and comfortable with several systems open at once.

Experience
Remote Customer Service Agent, Clearline Support Partners (home-based), April 2023 to present
- Take inbound calls for a bank client, helping customers with balances, account questions and payment issues.
- Confirm each caller's identity against the account security checklist before discussing any details, and follow the client's compliance script on every call.
- Juggle the phone system, the account database and the case management tool during the same call.
- Log the outcome of every interaction in the case management tool with accurate notes so the next agent has full context.
- Stayed calm during a service outage in March when callers were angry and waiting in long queues, and kept the same friendly tone through the shift.
- Flagged a suspicious card-not-present charge pattern to the fraud team, which led to the card being blocked the same day.

Customer Service Representative, Harbor Telecom, June 2021 to March 2023
- Handled billing and technical support calls for residential broadband customers, with a focus on first-call resolution.
- Trained six new starters on call handling and the escalation process.
- Reviewed a sample of calls each week against the quality scorecard and coached agents on tone and accuracy.
- Took part in the rollout of a new knowledge base that cut average handling time on common billing questions.

Education
BSc Business Management, Lagos Business School, 2020

Certifications
General insurance licence (Level 2), 2022

Skills
Phone support, Salesforce, Zendesk, Microsoft Office, conflict resolution, CRM documentation.

Name: Hannah Brooks
Summary: Retail customer service associate with 18 months of front-line experience. Strong phone communication and listening skills, patient, organized, and quick to learn new software.

Experience
Customer Service Associate, Greenfield Home Stores, February 2025 to present
- Serve customers in person at the returns desk and answer questions by phone when the store line is busy.
- Listen carefully to upset customers and stay composed while finding a fix for their order problem.
- Confirm the customer's identity with photo ID at the returns desk and follow store security procedures before any money is returned.
- Comfortable moving between several systems: the point-of-sale system, the stock lookup tool and the returns database, often at the same time during busy shifts.
- Record every customer issue accurately in the store's tracking system, so the head office can follow up.
- Handle a steady flow of customers in a fast-paced store and keep the queue moving on Saturdays.
- Passed on customer feedback to the store manager each week, which led to a clearer returns sign at the entrance.

Sales Assistant, Lumen Electronics, August 2023 to January 2025
- Helped customers choose products and processed payments and exchanges.
- Restocked displays and kept the sales floor organized during weekly deliveries.
- Completed an in-house retail banking training course covering card payments. This was an internal course with no licensed credential.

Education
Diploma in Business Studies, Hartfield College, 2023

Skills
POS systems, Microsoft Excel, customer relations, conflict resolution, basic English and Spanish.

Name: Ravi Desai
Summary: Freelance bookkeeper with six years of experience supporting small construction and hospitality businesses. Careful with numbers, organized, and used to working alone from a home office. I keep client records tidy and I like clear month-end routines.

Experience
Freelance Bookkeeper, Self-employed, March 2020 to present
- Keep month-end books for nine small business clients, including bank reconciliations and payroll summaries.
- Juggled QuickBooks, client document portals and bank feed exports at the same time during tax season.
- Prepare quarterly VAT returns and send monthly management reports to owners by email.
- I work from a quiet home office with a 100 Mbps hard-wired connection and a USB headset for client video calls.
- Clients send documents through my portal and I return a monthly summary pack with notes on anything that needs their attention.
- Maintain a checklist for each client's year-end close so nothing is missed between accounting periods.

Accounts Assistant, Ridgeway Builders Ltd, September 2017 to February 2020
- Processed supplier invoices, matched purchase orders and filed expense claims.
- Reconciled site cost reports against the monthly budget and flagged overspends to the project manager.
- Set up a simple filing routine for receipts and subcontractor invoices, which cut year-end paperwork by several days.
- Helped prepare the annual accounts pack for the owner and the external accountant each spring.
- Supported the owner with cash flow forecasts for the next quarter.

Education
Higher National Diploma in Accounting, Kingsway College, 2017

Skills
QuickBooks, Xero, Excel, payroll basics, bank reconciliation, VAT, invoice processing, cash flow forecasting.
